title: ⏸️ New Pause Menu & Smoother Ads (v1.2.0) ✨
message: A beautiful new Pause menu, clearer ad choices and smoother play after a checkpoint.
points: 🎬 You Choose — Manual Tasks now ask first: tap Watch Ad to unlock the job, or Cancel.
⏳ Loading Ad Card — See a loading card while the ad gets ready, so the game never looks stuck.
🚩 Back to Work Faster — After a Last Checkpoint ad, you go straight back to driving.
⏸️ New Pause Menu — A fresh, premium look with Resume, Restart, Quit and sound buttons.
📏 Neater Buttons — The buttons on the failed journey screen are now the same size.
⭐ Rate Inside the Game — Give the game a rating without leaving it.
🔧 Bug fixes and smoother play.

title: 💎 Lifetime Premium & Secret Scratch Card (v1.1.0) ✨
message: Go Premium once and keep it forever. Scratch the gold card to find a special price, and enjoy faster sounds and clearer messages.
points: 💎 NEW: Lifetime Premium — Pay once and keep it forever. No subscription.
🚫 No Ads — Play without any ads between your work.
🔓 Every Manual Task Unlocked — Start any job right away, no ads to watch.
⛽ Refuel Without Ads — Fill up any machine at the depot any time.
🎟️ Secret Scratch Card — Scratch the gold card on the Premium screen to find a special price. It lasts for 1 hour only!
🎉 Premium Celebration — Confetti, music and your own Premium page when you join.
✅ Premium Badge — A green PREMIUM badge on the home screen shows that Premium is on.
🔄 Restore Anytime — Premium is linked to your Google account. Tap Restore to get it back on any phone.
🔔 Update Notes — See what's new in every update, right inside the game. Check any time in Settings.
🔐 Privacy & Ad Choices — Players in Europe and the UK can change their ad choices in Settings.
🔊 Faster Sounds — Buttons and sounds are ready as soon as the game opens.
💬 Clearer Messages — New, easy-to-read message bars.
🔧 Bug fixes and smoother play.
